headline: Latin American Steel Fund Drops 3.9% as Imports and Global Sell-off Hit Producers
summary: Steel producers CSN, Gerdau, and Ternium sank, driving a Latin American steel fund down 3.92% over seven days due to cheap Asian imports and market risk aversion.
why: CSN and Gerdau are major South American steel manufacturers producing industrial and construction materials.

impacts.name: Latin American Steel Sector
impacts.why: Steel equities fell nearly 4% as Asian import pricing pressures impacted margins.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Competition from lower-cost Asian steel imports combined with global market selling led to declines across regional steel shares.
